lessons_used: Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 3 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%, +11.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 4 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful, winning 1 test (+7.0%), while 1 test showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) and reordering steps (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test each (-7.5% and -3.8% respectively) and showed no clear effect in all other tests.
Copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured, +7.0% vs +11.4% measured) and overestimated changes that showed no clear effect or lost.

candidates.title: Companion Visual Style Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new visual showcase screen before choose_path highlighting different companion art styles and animations.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s but a mean time of 514s, indicating hesitation. Adding visual preview screens previously yielded up to +15.4% conversion wins.

new_companion_style_intro.headline: Explore Companion Visual Styles
new_companion_style_intro.body: Preview how your pet looks and reacts on your desktop before picking a creation path.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a visual style showcase screen within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: New visual screens historically drive high conversion, targeting step hesitation.

candidates.title: Desktop Environment Readiness Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen during home setup that checks display overlay access and screen permissions before desktop spawn.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets (3 emails) about pets not displaying on desktop or app failing to open, causing drop-offs prior to finish.
